Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning regional transit authority ballot propositions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to ballot propositions for regional transitauthorities; and adding a new section to chapter 81.112 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 81.112 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any proposition to be submitted to the voters shall addresseither the capital projects or the maintenance and operation expenses.The two topics shall not be combined in one proposition. (2) The proposition for capital projects shall state that the taxwill cease upon redemption of the bonds for the capital project, whichmust not exceed twenty years. (3) The proposition for maintenance and operation expenses shallstate that the tax is permanent.
